THE JOURNEY OF THE BIBLE

The Start of God’s Communication

The written Word of God began after approximately 2500 years of Man’s history. Prior to that, God spoke through a few specific men. He also spoke to humanity in various ways such as nature, dreams, visions, angels, and symbols.

Hebrews 1:1

God, who at various times and in various ways spoke in time past to the fathers by the prophets

The Beginnings of the Written Word

The written Word of God started with Moses who received the Covenant of God on Mount Sinai.

The Covenant or Law was inscribed on tablets of stone by the finger of God. These tablets were then placed inside a holy sacred box called the Ark of the Covenant. Over time, scribes would carefully copy these words onto leather, clay tablets, wood, and other surfaces.

Deuteronomy 31:9-11

So Moses wrote this law and delivered it to the priests, the sons of Levi, who bore the ark of the covenant of the LORD, and to all the elders of Israel. And Moses commanded them, saying: “At the end of every seven years, at the appointed time in the year of release, at the Feast of Tabernacles, when all Israel comes to appear before the LORD your God in the place which He chooses, you shall read this law before all Israel in their hearing.

04

B. ARRANGEMENT OF THE BIBLE

Visual chart available below ↓

The English word, Bible, is from the Latin word - biblia, which means “books”. It is essentially a collection of books, and has been referred to as the “Book of books”.

The Bible is divided by translators into two sections – the Old and the New Testament

The Old Testament – a collection of books that cover almost 3,600 years of human history consisting of 39 books.

Law

Genesis to Deuteronomy

History

Joshua to Esther

Poetry

Job to Song of Solomon

Prophecy

Major Prophets: Isaiah to Daniel Minor Prophets: Hosea to Malachi

The New Testament – a collection of 27 books written over a period of about 100 years. This portion of the Bible covers the details of a person named Jesus Christ. We will learn more about Jesus in future lessons.

Gospels

Matthew to John

Acts of the Apostles

Acts

Epistles

Romans to Jude

Prophecy

Revelation

How do I use the Bible?

The Books in the Bible is further divided by translators into Chapters and Verses for referencing purposes.

GenesisBook1Chapter:1Verse

THE BIBLE IS THE INSPIRED WORD OF GOD

2 Timothy 3:16

All Scripture is given by inspiration of God, and is profitable for doctrine, for reproof, for correction, for instruction in righteousness

Inspiration – “God Breathed”

The Bible said over 3,800 times, “The Lord said”, “the Lord spoke” and “God said”.

Here are two examples of men of God writing what God spoke to them:

Paul [Writing to the church in Corinth]:

1 Corinthians 14:37

“…the things that I write are the commandments of the Lord.”

Jeremiah:

Jeremiah 30:1-2

“The word that came to Jeremiah from the Lord saying, Thus speaks the Lord God of Israel, saying: Write in a book for yourself all the words that I have spoken to you.”

FACTS ABOUT THIS AMAZING BOOK

Here are some examples of evidence to show the Bible’s relevance and validity in our world today:

Scientific Evidence

Spherical Earth verses Flat Earth

There were ancient cultures and civilizations including Greece (until the Classical period), the Bronze Age and Iron Age civilizations of the near East (until the Hellenistic period), India (until the Gupta period), and China until the 17th century that subscribed to a flat earth belief.

Source: Lucien Levy-Bruhl, Primitive Mentality (repr. Boston: Beacon, 1966) 353, H. B. Alexander, The Mythology of All Races 10: North American (repr. New York: Cooper Square, 1964) 249.

Isaiah 40:22

It is He who sits above the circle of the earth

Number of stars in the sky

  • Ptolemyin the 2nd century - 1022 stars
  • Tycho Brahe (1598) - 965 stars
  • Johannes Hevelius (1687) – 1564 stars

It was not until the 1600s that they found out by using a telescope that stars were innumerable.

Jeremiah 33:22

As the host of heaven cannot be numbered, nor the sand of the sea measured, so will I multiply the descendants of David My servant and the Levites who minister to Me.

Earth hung upon nothing

The question of what the earth was hanging upon was not answered until Newton’s discovery of the law of universal gravitation in 1687. Job discusses the fact that the earth has an invisible support and hangs on nothing.

Job 26:7

He stretches out the north over empty space; He hangs the earth on nothing.

Medical Evidence

  • Bloodletting

Doctors believed they could cure George Washington’s pain and shortness of breath by removing blood from his body in a process called “bloodletting”. He died that very night. We know today, and the Bible had it written many years ago, that blood is needed to sustain life.

Source: PBS News hour, 15 December 2014,

<www.pbs.org/newshouse>

Leviticus 17:11

For the life of the flesh is in the blood, and I have given it to you upon the altar to make atonement for your souls; for it is the blood that makes atonement for the soul.

Historical Evidence

Accounts of worldwide flood

Presence of multiple flood narratives in ancient literature supports the Biblical story of a worldwide flood (Noah’s Ark).

“The Great Flood had such a profound impact that it became part of various ancient cultures. The early aborigines of nearly every country of the world have preserved records of the universal flood. Anthropologist Dr.

Richard Andree has collected 46 different flood accounts from North and South America, 20 from Asia, 5 from Europe, 7 from Africa, and 10 from the South Sea Islands and Australia.”

Source: Willmington, Willmington’s Guide to the Bible, 950.

Archaeological findings of locations and artefacts

Example: Tel Dan Stela—the ninth-century B.C. inscription that furnished the first historical evidence of King David outside the Bible

Siloam pool in Jesus time - Archaeologists excavated part of a monumental pool where Jesus performed the miracle of restoring sight to a blind man in the Gospel of John

Source: http://www.biblicalarchaeology.org

  • Discovery of the Dead Sea Scrolls Scrolls of approximately 2000-year-old manuscripts were found in 1947 by Arab Bedouins who tended their flocks in the region.

These scrolls contain representations of every book of the traditional Hebrew canon, except Esther.

Upon comparing these manuscripts with our modern Bible, they found them to be 95% identical (word for word) with 5% variation consisting primarily obvious slips of the pen and spelling alterations.

Source: Collins, John J. (1992b), “Dead Sea Scrolls,” The Anchor Bible Dictionary, ed. David Noel Freedman (New York: Doubleday), 2:85-101.

Archer, Gleason, Jr. (1974), A Survey of Old Testament Introduction (Chicago, IL: Moody).

Textual Preservation Evidence

The accuracy and reliability of an ancient document is dependent on the “time gap” between the time the original author wrote it, and the first copy written. The number of available manuscripts also increases its credibility.

Time Gap: The gap of time from when the author wrote the original to the time the first copy was written.

TIME GAP These handwritten documents, originals and copies, were called manuscripts.

The smaller the time gap between the original and copy, the less room for error.

Here is a table comparing how widely accepted ancient writings measure up with the Bible.

Contrast: New Testament with Other Books of Antiquity

Prophetic Evidence

The Bible contains numerous prophecies. Prophecy is literally history written in advance (before it happens). Because no man can see the future but God alone, prophecies that are fulfilled further show that the Bible is a supernatural book.

Example:

  • The Rebirth of Israel as a Nation
  • The nation of Israel (both Northern and Southern) was destroyed and overthrown by 587 B.C.
  • Ever since then, Israel was in captivity by foreign empires.
  • God sent prophets to tell Israel that there will come a day that the nation will be rebirthed and Jews will gather back in their land again (see Amos 9:14-15, Isaiah 66:7-8)

This prophecy was fulfilled in 1948, 15 May when the United Nations announce Israel as a sovereign nation. Till this day, Israel is the only country that is born again.

  • The Coming of Messiah

Prior to the time of Jesus, Jews were given over 100 prophecies describing the coming of a Messiah (a king who would deliver Israel and set up the kingdom of God).

An expert in mathematical probabilities, Peter Stoner, wrote in Science Speaks that if only 8 of the prophecies in the Old Testament concerning Messiah were fulfilled, the probability of their actually coming to pass would be 1 in 10 to the 17th degree – that probability is 1 in 100,000,000,000,000,000.

That’s one in one hundred quadrillion!

The fulfilment of prophecy in the life of Jesus was not accidental. Keep in mind that Jesus did not just fulfil 8 prophecies, He fulfilled 108.

07

FAITH

Although there is evidence to show us that the Bible can be trusted, it is ultimately a book that requires faith.

Romans 10:17

So then faith comes by hearing, and hearing by the word of God.

Hebrews 11:6

But without faith it is impossible to please Him, for he who comes to God must believe that He is, and that He is a rewarder of those who diligently seek Him.

God rewards those who put their faith in His Word.

Hebrews 4:2

For indeed the gospel was preached to us as well as to them; but the word which they heard did not profit them, not being mixed with faith in those who heard it.

Mark 16:20

And they went out and preached everywhere, the Lord working with them and confirming the word through the accompanying signs.

Amen.

The world says, “Prove it to me and then I’ll believe it,” but God says the opposite, “Believe Me and I’ll prove it.”

08

HOW DOES GOD VIEW HIS WORD?

He magnifies His Word above His name

Psalm 138:2

I will worship toward Your holy temple, And praise Your name For Your lovingkindness and Your truth; For You have magnified Your word above all Your name.

His Word is alive, powerful, active and sharp

Hebrews 4:12

For the word of God is living and powerful, and sharper than any two-edged sword, piercing even to the division of soul and spirit, and of joints and marrow, and is a discerner of the thoughts and intents of the heart.

His Word does not return void

Isaiah 55:11

So shall My word be that goes forth from My mouth; It shall not return to Me void, But it shall accomplish what I please, And it shall prosper in the thing for which I sent it.

His Word is Truth

John 17:17

Sanctify them by Your truth. Your word is truth.

His Word is everlasting

Matthew 24:35

Heaven and earth will pass away, but My words will by no means pass away.

09

BENEFITS OF THE WORD OF GOD

Able to make us wise

Psalm 119:98-99

You, through Your commandments, make me wiser than my enemies; For they are ever with me. 99 I have more understanding than all my teachers, For Your testimonies are my meditation.

Provides a guide for life

Psalm 119:133

Direct my steps by Your word, and let no iniquity have dominion over me.

Proverbs 3:5-6

Trust in the Lord with all your heart, and lean not on your own understanding; in all your ways acknowledge Him, and He shall direct your paths.

Reveals God’s plan for humanity and the world

John 3:16

For God so loved the world that He gave His only begotten Son, that whoever believes in Him should not perish but have everlasting life.

Ultimately, it allows us to know and experience its author, God

John 5:39

You search the Scriptures, for in them you think you have eternal life; and these are they which testify of Me.

To preach the Bible as ‘the handbook for life,’ or as the answer to every question, rather than as the revelation of Christ, is to turn the Bible into an entirely different book. This is how the Pharisees approached Scripture, as we can see clearly from the questions they asked Jesus. For the Pharisees, the Scriptures were a source of trivia for life’s dilemmas.

—Michael Horton

10

HOW SHOULD I RESPOND TO THE WORD OF GOD

Revelation 1:3

Blessed is he who reads and those who hear the words of this prophecy, and keep those things which are written in it; for the time is near.

READ (KNOW THE WORD)

Psalm 119:33

Teach me, O LORD, the way of Your statutes, And I shall keep it to the end.

Familiarize yourself with the Bible by being open to learn from it. Allow God to speak to you through His Word.

HEAR (UNDERSTAND THE WORD)

Proverbs 2:1-5

My son, if you receive my words, and treasure my commands within you, 2 So that you incline your ear to wisdom, and apply your heart to understanding; 3 Yes, if you cry out for discernment, and lift up your voice for understanding, 4 If you seek her as silver, And search for her as for hidden treasures; 5 Then you will understand the fear of the LORD, And find the knowledge of God.

God wants us to understand His Word. To do so, we need to know how to study and interpret the Word accurately.

2 Peter 1:20

knowing this first, that no prophecy of Scripture is of any private interpretation

God never intended for anyone to make up their own interpretation. Therefore, we must interpret the Bible using the Bible and not our personal opinion.

How do I understand the Word of God?

Read its context (two or three witnesses)

Sometimes, to seek out the true meaning of what the writer is trying to communicate, it would require you to read surrounding passages of Scripture.

Deuteronomy 19:15

“One witness shall not rise against a man concerning any iniquity or any sin that he commits; by the mouth of two or three witnesses the matter shall be established.

2 Corinthians 13:1

This will be the third time I am coming to you. “By the mouth of two or three witnesses every word shall be established.”

Do not add or subtract from it

Deuteronomy 4:2

You shall not add to the word which I command you, nor take from it, that you may keep the commandments of the Lord your God which I command you.

Proverbs 30:6

Do not add to His Words, Lest He rebuke you, and you be found a liar.

Revelation 22:18-19

For I testify to everyone who hears the words of the prophecy of this book: If any- one adds to these things, God will add to him the plagues that are written in this book; and if anyone takes away from the words of the book of this prophecy, God shall take away his part from the Book of Life, from the holy city, and from the things which are written in this book.

Invest time to study it

2 Timothy 2:15 (KJV)

Study to shew thyself approved unto God, a workman that needeth not to be ashamed, rightly dividing the word of truth.

Sincerely seek the Lord using His Word and let the Holy Spirit illuminate your understanding

John 14:26 (KJV)

But the Comforter, which is the Holy Ghost, whom the Father will send in my name, he shall teach you all things, and bring all things to your remembrance, whatsoever I have said unto you.

KEEP (APPLY THE WORD)

James 1:22

But be doers of the word, and not hearers only, deceiving yourselves.

Joshua 1:8

This Book of the Law shall not depart from your mouth, but you shall meditate in it day and night, that you may observe to do according to all that is written in it. For then you will make your way prosperous, and then you will have good success.
